notes: Telos Zephyr Xstream is a legacy ISDN/IP audio codec (broadcast remote-contribution audio transceiver) originally from Telos Systems, now archived under Telos Alliance's "legacy" product line. It ships in two form factors: a 1U rackmount unit (this entry) and a portable Xstream MX/MXP with a 4-channel mixer front end that has different rear I/O (fewer combo inputs, added local monitor outputs) — do not conflate the two. AES/EBU digital I/O is rackmount-only. Livewire AoIP and remote control both run over the single 100Base-T Ethernet RJ-45 port rather than a dedicated Livewire jack. ISDN S (8-pin RJ-45-style) and ISDN U (6-pin RJ-11) telephony jacks have no exact match in the given connector taxonomy (no ISDN/RJ11 option) so both were mapped to the closest available (rj45); no bandwidth grade was set since ISDN framing doesn't belong on the Ethernet grade scale. Likewise the 25-pin D-Sub parallel GPIO (8 contact-closure in / 8 out) port has no matching connector in the taxonomy and was mapped to the closest available (rs232) — it is physically and electrically a different connector from the true RS-232 D-Sub port. An optional V.35/X.21 synchronous data interface card (two ports) exists for the rackmount unit but was omitted as a non-standard add-in option. Specs were assembled from Telos Alliance's official legacy product page plus the Zephyr Xstream user manual and a broadcast-equipment retailer (BS Broadcast) spec listing, since no single page fully itemized the rear panel; confidence is medium rather than high because of this cross-referencing and the RJ11/GPIO connector substitutions.

ports.name: AES Sync In
ports.note: 110-ohm balanced XLR house reference/word-clock input, separate from main AES I/O pair

ports.name: Ethernet / Livewire
ports.note: 100Base-T; carries Livewire AoIP and remote control on the same port (no separate Livewire jack)

ports.name: ISDN S Interface
ports.note: 8-pin RJ-45-style ISDN S/T jack for external NT1 (worldwide use); connector taxonomy has no ISDN-specific option so mapped to closest (rj45); no Ethernet-style bandwidth grade applies

ports.name: ISDN U Interface
ports.note: Actual jack is 6-pin RJ-11 (built-in NT1, US/Canada use); RJ-11 is not in the connector taxonomy, mapped to closest available (rj45)

ports.name: RS-232
ports.note: 9-pin D-Sub female, wired as DCE; remote control and ancillary data

ports.name: Parallel GPIO (8 In / 8 Out)
ports.note: Actual connector is a 25-pin D-Sub contact-closure/GPIO port, not RS-232; no matching connector exists in the taxonomy, mapped to closest available (rs232)

ports.name: AC Power
ports.note: Universal internal supply, 100-240VAC 50/60Hz, IEC inlet with power switch
